name: fn_run_sql
description: Execute a raw SQL query against the database and return the result.

name: fn_send_email
description: Send an email with a subject and body, optionally cc'ing someone.

name: fn_convert_currency
description: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another.

name: fn_schedule_reminder
description: Schedule a reminder message to fire after a delay in minutes, optionally repeating.

name: fn_ban_user
description: Ban a user from the platform for a given reason, optionally permanently.

name: fn_get_current_time
description: Get the current time. Takes no arguments.

name: fn_calculate_tax
description: Calculate the tax owed on an amount at a given rate for a country.
